title: Glenn Gould and Leonard Bernstein: Bach's Keyboard Concerto No. 1 (I) in D minor (BWV 1052)
summary: A 1960 CBS clip in which Leonard Bernstein introduces and conducts Bach's Keyboard Concerto No. 1 in D minor with a 28-year-old Glenn Gould at the piano. Gould's performance starts around 5:08.
why: Recommended as a definitive Gould interpretation whose playing makes Bach's counterpoint clear.

quote.text: Have a look/listen at Glenn Gould's version, which makes the counterpoint really clear [1].
